data.name: Interceptor ~ Maneuver
data.description: You can expend your psionic focus as an immediate action when an enemy you threaten attacks one of your allies to make a single melee attack or bull rush attempt against that enemy.  Your attack or bull rush attempt is resolved before the enemy's attack.  If you made a melee attack and it is successful, the struck enemy takes a -%1 penalty on the attack and damage rolls of the attack that triggered this maneuver.|InterceptorTranceBonus
